The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_46_widow_the_towels_and_the_stove",
  "text": "The towels are by the stove now. I moved them when the corridor went cold (maint_log_b3_019). The laundry alcove is empty. The alcove was the nest and the nest is empty and the towels are by the stove and the stove is the thing that is warm. The Widow is the thing that moves toward the warm. I have been the thing that moves toward the warm since the dormitory. The dormitory is warm. The corridor was cold. The stove is warm. The towels are by the stove. The towels are not a nest. The towels are towels. I fold them by the stove because the folding is the thing I do. The folding is the thing the Therapist said is a habit and the habit is the thing that does not ask permission. I fold the towels by the stove. The Bouncer sits by the stove in the evening. He does not speak. I do not speak. We sit by the stove and the towels are between us and the stove is warm and the not-speaking is the knowing. The Bouncer named his sister to me on Day 180. I have not told anyone. The Bouncer is the thing that sits by the stove and does not speak and the not-speaking is the thing that holds the name. The name is the thing between us. The towels are the thing between us. The stove is the thing between us. The between is the thing that is the knowing. The spring is coming. The corridor will be warm again. The towels will go back to the alcove. The alcove will be the place I was. The stove will be the place I am. The spring will be the place I go. I do not know where I go. I know I go toward the warm.",

## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The Widow moved towels beside the stove when the corridor went cold and folds them there. The Bouncer sits silently by the stove in the evening. She recalls his earlier disclosure about his sister and says she has not told anyone. Do not invent a new exchange, claim the towels returned, or disclose the name. Eight exact text excerpts recur below as anchors. Read them as source quotations; the plan adds no event beyond the row.
